inventory: DF-007 tracked TypeORM entity source reconciliation

fieldDispositions.accountId: Account/job scope key validated by the accepted Authentication owner; envelope supplies account scope.
fieldDispositions.idempotencyKey: operational idempotency value; do not serialize as account export content
fieldDispositions.leaseOwner: worker coordination value; not account export content
fieldDispositions.coverageSummary: Exported through the bounded allowlisted exportJob projection in J2; raw stored JSON is not emitted.
fieldDispositions.lastErrorCode: Exported through the stable sanitized exportJob error-code projection in J2.

scope: Tracked apps/**/*.entity.ts and libs/**/*.entity.ts; source-only; no runtime data or secret/config reads.
limitations: This is a structural catalog refresh, not a semantic ownership closure or exhaustive store inventory.
Raw SQL, unlisted/migration-only schemas, non-ORM stores, external providers, object storage, logs, browser state, queues, caches and backups remain separate reconciliation work.
Entity registration, physical schema, FK/cascade behavior and account ownership semantics are not proved by this catalog.
The untracked Directory files remain excluded and untouched.
reconciliationGate: Before DF-007 acceptance, reconcile tracked entities and migration-only tables against runtime datasource/repository registrations, raw SQL and non-ORM stores, then record an explicit owner disposition for every candidate and verify source hashes at the implementation revision.
